about.heading: Hello! I'm Louis Freeman.
about.subline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer · London

conversation.a: I'm a full-stack engineer working across React/TypeScript and Ruby on Rails on a multi-region fintech platform. I joined Hnry as one of the first two engineers on the UK team, which is now eight strong. I own delivery end to end, from hard integrations (a UK banking and card provider, identity verification across three countries, and HMRC) through to the product surfaces built on top of them, with a customer-centric approach throughout.
highlight: one of the first two engineers on the UK team

conversation.a: I line-manage three intermediate engineers, run engineering chapter sessions for the wider team, and lead AI engineering for the UK business, working with operations and marketing as well as engineering.
highlight: lead AI engineering for the UK business

conversation.q: How did you get into software?
conversation.a: Before software I studied Product Design & Manufacture Engineering at the University of Nottingham, which still shapes how I think about building things people actually use.
